companyIntro.name: CloudLoop Software
companyIntro.mission: Make customers successful so they renew, expand and recommend us.
companyIntro.culture: Retention is a team sport. Health scores drive action, not reports.

projectBackground.name: Renewal Risk Programme
projectBackground.context: Several accounts look unhappy and renewals are close. Leadership wants a forecast and a save plan.

manager.name: Rachel Kim
manager.note: Don't wait for the renewal call. Watch health, talk early, and show value.

assignment.title: Save and grow accounts
assignment.brief: Calculate churn, NRR and LTV, weight the renewal pipeline in Excel and write a renewal-risk plan.

documents.name: Customer Base
documents.note: 500 customers at the start of the year; 25 lost.

documents.name: Unit Economics
documents.note: ARPA 200 a month; gross margin 80%; monthly churn 2%.

tasks.title: Customer Churn
tasks.prompt: 500 customers at the start; 25 lost. What is churn (%)?
tasks.mistake: Mixing new and old customers distorts churn.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Net Revenue Retention
tasks.prompt: Start MRR 100,000; expansion 12,000; contraction 3,000; churn 5,000. What is NRR (%)?
tasks.reasoning: NRR above 100% means growth from existing customers.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Customer Lifetime Value
tasks.prompt: ARPA 200 a month, gross margin 80%, monthly churn 2%. What is LTV?
tasks.reasoning: LTV guides how much to spend on retention.
tasks.mistake: Using revenue instead of margin overstates LTV.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Health Score
tasks.prompt: What is a good health score built from?
options: Usage, adoption, support and sentiment signals
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Weighted Renewals (Excel)
tasks.prompt: Weighted ARR in column D = ARR x probability % / 100.
tasks.mistake: Treating all renewals as certain overstates the forecast.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Renewal-Risk Plan
tasks.modelAnswer: Expected renewals are 171,000 of 250,000, so 79,000 is at risk, mainly Beta at 60% and Gamma at 30%. For Beta we will hold an executive call this week to review usage and unmet needs, and for Gamma we will offer a training session and a trial of the missing feature. We will track health scores weekly and reforecast before the renewal date. Our NRR of 104% shows expansion can offset some loss.
tasks.reasoning: A good plan quantifies risk, names actions and sets a review cadence.
tasks.mistake: Plans without owners and dates don't happen.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Silent Account
caseStudy.background: A large customer stopped logging in for six weeks. No one noticed until the renewal call, when they said they had already chosen a competitor.
questions: What signal would have warned you?
caseStudy.solution: CloudLoop added usage alerts and a 90-day renewal playbook.
